title: Jazzy Smoked Ukrainian Kombu Gratin
description: Malty, crisp Ukrainian dish featuring kombu, grilled to perfection and served in a claypot.
instructions: Soak kombu sheets in water for at least 30 minutes.
Drain and slice onion and garlic, then mix with caraway seeds, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Brush the interior of the claypot with grapeseed oil and add barley malt syrup, then layer with sliced onion and garlic mixture, and kombu sheets.
Cover the claypot and grill for 20 minutes, then carefully remove the cover and grill for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Note: This dish is traditionally served with a side of rye bread or dark rye crackers.
Note: Be sure to use a claypot that is safe for high heat and can withstand the grill temperatures.
